nodes.name: Ni foam cleaning
nodes.procedure: The Ni foam was sonicated in 0.1M HCl for 15 min followed by ethanol and deionized water sonication and rinsing.
nodes.source_text: Before electrode preparation, the Ni foam was sonicated in 0.1M HCl for 15min followed by ethanol and deionized water sonication and rinsing.

nodes.name: CoFeP electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The as-cleaned substrates were immersed in a growth solution containing 100 mM sodium hypophosphite (NaH₂PO₂) as precursor for phosphorous (P), 200 mM NH₄Cl, and a 20 mM equimolar concentration of iron(II) sulfate (FeSO₄) and cobalt(II) chloride (CoCl₂) as the metal precursor. Electrodeposition was carried out by applying constant current of 5 mA/cm² for 60 s followed by 600 s with 50 mA/cm². After deposition, the electrode was removed and thoroughly washed with deionized water and dried in vacuum oven at 60°C. Control samples of CoP and FeP were prepared following the same procedure, maintaining the metal concentration at 10 mM.

nodes.name: Pt/C polyol synthesis
nodes.procedure: 1 ml of ethanol solution containing H₂PtCl₆ of 1000 parts per million was prepared and added dropwise to graphite substrate (5 cm by 5 cm) and dried at 60°C. The graphite substrate was immersed in 150 ml of ethylene glycol at 150°C for 10 min and rinsed thoroughly with deionized water and dried in atmospheric oven at 60°C before the deposition of platinum nanoparticles.

nodes.evidence_snippet: The metal content was quantified by ICP-OES, obtaining a ratio Fe/Co of 0.4.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoFeP XPS survey confirms presence of Co, Fe, P, O, and Ni. High-resolution Co 2p shows peaks at ~781.1 and 797.0 eV deconvoluted to Co⁰ (778.0 eV), Co³⁺ (780.7 eV), Co²⁺ (782.7 eV) with satellites; Fe 3p shows primary peak at ~56 eV resolved to Fe³⁺ (56.3 eV) and Fe²⁺ (55.1 eV).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS survey spectrum confirms the presence of Co, Fe, P, O, and Ni in CoFeP sample (Fig. 2, B and C, and fig. S9). High-resolution Co 2p spectra of the CoP and CoFeP samples are shown in Fig. 2C. Two distinctive regions located could be observed at ∼781.1 and 797.0 eV... The 3p peak can be resolved into two contributions at 56.3 and 55.1 eV, which are ascribed to Fe³⁺ and Fe²⁺, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: CoFeP ECSA estimated from double-layer capacitance C_dl = 26.6 mF/cm² (10-fold increase vs Ni foam 2.4 mF/cm²), associated to dendritic growth.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemically active surface area (ECSA) was investigated... The C_dl of CoFeP (26.6 mF/cm²) shows a 10-fold increase compared to the Ni substrates (2.4 mF/cm²), associated to the dendritic growth...

nodes.characterization_summary: ACC consists of carbon fibers of 5 to 10 μm with apparent smooth surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The auxiliary electrode made of ACC was examined by scanning microscopy, as shown in Fig. 3A. The electrode consists of carbon fibers of 5 to 10 μm with an apparent smooth surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: ACC has surface area of 1330 m²/g with pore size distribution predominantly in 0.4 to 3 nm range.
nodes.evidence_snippet: N₂ adsorption measurements yield a surface area of 1330 m²/g as estimated from Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) method with a pore size distribution predominantly in the range of 0.4 to 3 nm (micropores) as shown in Fig. 3B.
